% Pattern: structure/declaration. The class reads its theorems from a
% configuration file with \InputIfFileExists, and the file declares a hidden
% proof only under a flag that an option of the class sets; without the option
% the hidden proof is a comment. So the lemma and the definition are items,
% numbered within the section, and the hidden proof is not. Seen in the gold
% pilot (set X).
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
% want defn-1 definition 1.2
\documentclass[english]{cfgjour}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{lemma} Every compact space is fine. \end{lemma}
\begin{proof} Cover the space by balls. \end{proof}
\begin{hproof} A note for the authors. \end{hproof}
\begin{defn} A space is nice when it is compact. \end{defn}
\end{document}
